# 1141 Song, Jin and Western Xia map — attribution and license

The historical illustration is Ian Kiu, [Jinn and Sung Dynasties 1141](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jinn_and_Sung_Dynasties_1141.png), **original 2007 edition** ([exact archived image](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/archive/e/e5/20181119022251%21Jinn_and_Sung_Dynasties_1141.png)). The author released it under [Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). Commons identifies it as based on Albert Herrmann's 1935 *Historical and Commercial Atlas of China*. Ian Kiu's [blank base map](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Blank_China_with_terrain_and_bcoast.png) is also CC BY 3.0.

World History Atlas extracted the three color regions, filled text holes, generalized them and registered the illustration to geographic coordinates. The derived file is shared under CC BY 3.0; retain this attribution, the license link, and the indication of modifications. Its source illustration and fitting base are retained in `references/china-song-1141/`. The source is a dated schematic interpretation; Jin's northeast is cropped, and northern frontiers should not be read as precise or uniform control.
